sentences.en: The high quality camera took great photos in low light.
sentences.zh: 这台高质量相机在低光环境下拍出了很棒的照片。

sentences.en: I decided to buy a high quality camera for my travel blog.
sentences.zh: 我决定买一台高质量的相机来为我的旅行博客拍照。

sentences.en: The event organizers provided us with a high quality camera for recording the performances.
sentences.zh: 活动组织者为我们提供了一台高质量的相机用来拍摄表演。
